ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base layer consists of low-intensity black pixels. High-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal fluke tips. An extensive network of high-intensity annular rings is mapped across the mid-section and trailing regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate 125-degree opening and low relative vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration pattern extracted along the entire trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory observed from the central axis to the distal tips along the leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive constellation of high-contrast, roughly circular white annular pixel clusters distributed across over 70% of the visible ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive distribution of ring-shaped high-contrast markers across the entire visible surface.
